title: The exact genericity gap is the degree-collapse map d->d mod n; LovettUnionDegreesInjective is stated at the WRONG quotient for mu_n
evidence: Two independent probes with EXACT integer arithmetic at PROPER-SUBGROUP large primes in the prize regime (q ~ n^4, n << sqrt(q)), scripts/probes/_407_conn/probe_C016_degree_collapse.py and probe_C016_nvm_subtlety.py. (1) STRUCTURAL CORE CONFIRMED: full mu_n generalized-Vandermonde minor det[zeta^(e_j*i)] is nonzero IFF exponents distinct MOD n -- 3000/3000 random configs agree, 0 mismatch, at n=8 (q=4129), n=16 (q=65537), n=32 (q=1048609). Exactly matches the in-tree axiom-clean genVandermonde_rootsOfUnity_det_ne_zero_iff (RootsOfUnityVandermonde.lean), now verified at prize-regime proper subgroups, not the toy mu_8 in ZMod 73. (2) GAP LOCALIZED: thousands of exponent vectors distinct-AS-NATURALS but NOT distinct-mod-n give det=0 (e.g. n=8 [0,5,6,8,9,11,13,23] -> mod 8 [0,5,6,0,...] collapse). So the in-tree Lovett residual LovettUnionDegreesInjective (LovettPrimitiveDistinctDegree.lean, = injective vAbs(V_i)+e as NATURALS, fed to linearIndependent_of_injOn_natDegree over MvPolynomial) is genuinely at the WRONG quotient for mu_n; the faithful condition is injective (d mod n). The connection's headline 'gap = d->d mod n' is PROVEN for the full n-point evaluation domain. (3) NVM-COUNTERMODEL REFINEMENT: _wf407_nvm.lean's points {1,-1,zeta^2} (degrees {0,1,4}) all have order dividing 4 -- they lie in mu_4, NOT generic mu_8; {0,1,4} IS distinct mod 8 but collapses mod 4 (4==0 mod 4). So that countermodel's collapse is mod (order of <pts>)=4, slightly mis-cited as 'x^4 sends mu_8->mu_2'; the general gap map is d->d mod (order of subgroup generated by the points), = mod n exactly when points generate all of mu_n. (4) HONESTY/WALL TEST: even the corrected mod-n nonvanishing criterion is 0/1 ALGEBRAIC and archimedean-blind: at n=8 the full mu_n Vandermonde is trivially nonzero (distinct mod n) yet B=max_b|eta_b|=7.56, B/sqrt(n)=2.67; n=16 B=13.84, B/sqrt(n)=3.46. The det!=0 dichotomy carries ZERO information about the prize floor B. So proving SubgroupLovettUnionDegreesInjectiveModN certifies generic RS list-decoding but is provably silent at mu_n -- the W-genericity wall.
reduced_to: Sharpened open statement: replace the in-tree LovettUnionDegreesInjective (distinct-as-naturals) by SubgroupLovettUnionDegreesInjectiveModN -- injectivity of the n-core / degree-collapse map d->d mod n on the union-degree multiset vAbs(V_i)+e -- and route pFamUnion_linearIndependent over mu_n through genVandermonde_rootsOfUnity_det_ne_zero_iff. This is the FIRST mu_n-faithful GM-MDS reduction and its hypothesis is exactly n-core emptiness of the underlying partitions (distinct beta-numbers mod n). It is an achievable, axiom-clean Lean lemma. But it does NOT reduce the prize: the resulting condition is a 0/1 nonvanishing fact (algebraic, non-archimedean), whereas the prize floor B=max|eta_b| is an archimedean modulus (CLAIM3). The connection therefore reduces the abstract 'genericity barrier' to the concrete map d->d mod (ord<pts>) and PROVES why finishing LovettPrimitiveStep does not win the prize, but the open core remains.
wall: W-genericity (algebraic/non-archimedean vs archimedean): the mod-n NVM nonvanishing condition is logically blind to the prize modulus B=max|eta_b|. Welds to the same archimedean-vs-algebraic wall recorded for the whole NVM/GM-MDS/Lovett route in _wf407_nvm.lean and docs/kb/deltastar-conjecture-loop-algebraic-route-2026-06-13.md; NOT a reduction to BGK sqrt-cancellation.
honest_note: No closure. PROVEN parts: (a) the structural reformulation (gap = d->d mod n) is exact and machine-verified at prize-regime proper subgroups, restating the in-tree genVandermonde_rootsOfUnity_det_ne_zero_iff; (b) the in-tree LovettUnionDegreesInjective is provably at the wrong quotient for mu_n. CORRECTION to the connection record: the _wf407_nvm.lean countermodel exhibits collapse mod 4 (= order of the 3-point subset's subgroup mu_4), not mod 8; degrees {0,1,4} are distinct mod 8. The faithful map is d->d mod (order of <pts>), = mod n only on a full generating set. NOT shown / still open: that the corrected mod-n condition gives ANY handle on B; it is archimedean-blind (CLAIM3), so the connection cannot reduce the BGK/Paley sqrt-cancellation core -- it is a clean reduction of the genericity-gap restatement plus a proof that the algebraic NVM route is the wrong category for the prize. The proposed Lean lemma is honest, formalizable, and worth landing as the first mu_n-faithful GM-MDS reduction, but should be labeled (correctly, per the connection's own why_insightful) as 'finishing LovettPrimitiveStep does NOT win the prize.'
